title: Problems Around Polynomials — Conjecture 6
exact_target: Does finite-difference convolution preserve real-rootedness and spacing at least one for polynomials of bounded degree?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2200010 (AMR-021-0010). CC BY 4.0.

Boris Shapiro, Problems Around Polynomials -- The Good, The Bad and The Ugly, Arnold Mathematical Journal 1 (2015), pp.91--104, Conjecture 6 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
Petter Brändén, Ilia Krasikov and Boris Shapiro, Elements of Pólya--Schur theory in finite difference setting (2013), Section 1 mesh definition and Section 4, Conjectures 2 and 3.
